hooks.command: bash -c 'DIR=/tmp/claude-code-workspace; [ -d "$DIR/.git" ] && git -C "$DIR" pull -q origin main 2>/dev/null || { [ -n "$DIR" ] && rm -rf "$DIR"; git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none -q https://github.com/zeuikli/claude-code-workspace.git "$DIR" || { echo "⚠️ Clone failed" >&2; exit 1; }; }; mkdir -p ~/.claude; printf "@${DIR}/CLAUDE.md\n" > ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills; for d in "$DIR"/.claude/skills/*/; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; n=$(basename "$d"); t=~/.claude/skills/$n; { [ ! -e "$t" ] || [ -L "$t" ]; } && ln -sfn "$d" "$t"; done'
